negative_snippets:
⭐ Very disappointing stay – false rating and misleading photos

I booked this hotel through Booking.com based on its rating, but the reality was completely different.

Cleanliness was zero. The bed sheets were dirty and clearly already used by previous guests, which was unacceptable. The room was noisy all night, making it impossible to sleep — we didn’t sleep even one hour.

Because of these conditions, we had to check out early at 1:30 AM.

As a foreign traveler, I do not recommend this hotel at all. The rating is misleading, and the photos of the hotel and rooms appear to be heavily edited and do not reflect the real condition of the property.

Please be careful and do not be fooled by false ratings and pictures.
